title: Bram over zijn jeugd in Rotterdam
summary: Week 7 recap, then an imperfectum immersion with Bram about growing up in Rotterdam

blocks.title: Week 7 in het kort
blocks.body: This week you built the **imperfectum** — Dutch's past for description, background and habit. Quick recap: regular verbs take **-te/-de** by 't kofschip (*werkte, woonde*); the big irregulars are *was/waren, had/hadden, ging, kwam, zei, deed*; **toen** opens a past subclause with the verb at the end; and *vroeger* + a frequency adverb tells an old habit. Now let's hear it all from Bram.

rows: het was, ik had, ik ging

blocks.explain: *hebben* is irregular in the past: *had* (singular) / *hadden* (plural). *Wij hadden een hond.*

blocks.prompt: Put *fietsen* into the imperfectum for 'he': 'Hij ___ naar zijn werk.'
blocks.explain: *fietste*. *fiets* ends in **s**, a 't kofschip' letter, so it takes -te.

blocks.scene: You ask Bram what Rotterdam was like when he was a kid. He sits back, coffee in hand — proud, measured.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Bram, hoe was Rotterdam toen jij klein was?
lines.en: Bram, what was Rotterdam like when you were little?

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.nl: Anders, hoor. Toen ik klein was, woonde ik in Zuid, vlak bij de haven.
lines.en: Different, you know. When I was little, I lived in Zuid, right by the harbor.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: En wat deed je na school?
lines.en: And what did you do after school?

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.nl: We speelden altijd buiten. Er waren overal kranen en schepen.
lines.en: We always played outside. There were cranes and ships everywhere.
lines.spotlight: Habit plus description: *speelden* with *altijd*, *er waren* for the scene.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Klinkt stoer. Was het niet gevaarlijk?

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.nl: Soms wel. Maar mijn vader zei altijd: geen woorden maar daden.
lines.en: Sometimes, yeah. But my dad always said: no words, just action.
lines.spotlight: *zei* — the irregular past of *zeggen* — and the Rotterdam motto.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Miste je de stad toen je wegging?
lines.en: Did you miss the city when you left?

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.nl: Zeker. Amsterdam is mooi, maar Rotterdam had iets echts.
lines.en: Definitely. Amsterdam is pretty, but Rotterdam had something real.
lines.spotlight: *had* for a lasting past state — and a little Rotterdam pride.

questions.q: Where in Rotterdam did Bram live as a child?
What did Bram and his friends do after school?
What did Bram's father always say?

lines.nl: Toen ik klein was, woonde ik in Zuid.
lines.en: When I was little, I lived in Zuid.

lines.nl: Er waren overal kranen en schepen.
lines.en: There were cranes and ships everywhere.

blocks.prompt: Bram described his childhood city. Write three lines about a place from your own childhood in the imperfectum: where it was, what you did there, and how it was.
starters: Toen ik klein was, woonde ik…
